Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the time to chat with us yesterday. As discussed, attached is the take-home prompt for the Senior Inference Engineer role. Quick bullets to keep things simple: 

- Goal: build a short proof-of-concept and write a short design note (~1–2 pages) explaining trade-offs for latency vs cost for a sample workload.
- Deliverable: ZIP (code + README) or a public repo link + pdf design note.
- Starter repo: see starter_repo_link.txt (contains repo URL and a small sample dataset).
- Deadline: EOD Sunday, Oct 4 (PST). If you need alternate format, let us know.
- Reviewers: Soojin Lee and Priyom Das will evaluate; reviewers will focus on correctness, clarity, and production-readiness.

I've attached redwood_takehome_instructions_v2.pdf with acceptance criteria and scoring rubric summary. Please confirm you received these and reply if you have any questions about scope or the dataset.

Thanks — looking forward to seeing what you build.

— Ben
